messages:
Riya (CS): Quick recap from OceanCrest dry-run: three blockers we couldn't close during the sessionCIDR collision, customer-managed KMS refuses Decrypt, and Sumo Logic ingestion returns 403. They called this out in the renewal thread. Need P0 owners.
Ethan (NetEng): Which CIDR did they choose? I can check route overlap and propose options.
Riya (CS): OceanCrest insisted on 192.168.0.0/16 (carrier constraints). Our standard stacks assume 192.168.128.0/17. They said renumbering isn't possible this quarter.
Ethan (NetEng): If renumbering is blocked we have 2 paths: carve non-overlapping ranges in our management VPC + strict ACLs, or stand up a transit/proxy VPC and NAT traffic. Transit GW is more maintainable but slower to deliver. I'll draft effort/cost.
Marta (Security): KMS issue: their key policy denies account-root and only allows a tight role. Our service attempt returned: "AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform: kms:Decrypt on resource". We need their role ARN and for them to permit our service in the role trust policy and the key policy to permit the assumed role.
Riya (CS): They gave role arn:aws:iam::334455667788:role/Oceancrest-Redwood-Bridge but trust policy only allows their CI principal.
Ethan (NetEng): Marta, can you paste the minimal trust policy we can send to them?
Marta (Security): Minimal trust policy to paste: ```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{"Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":"arn:aws:iam::REDACTED:role/redwood-service"},"Action":"sts:AssumeRole"}]
}```
Marta (Security): For the key they must include a statement granting kms:Decrypt to the above role ARN (the assumed role, not root). I'll add a snippet into the ticket.
log-bot: Forward attempt 2026-03-21T18:40Z failed: HTTP 403 from Sumo. Error body: {"message":"403 Forbidden - invalid access id"}. Forwarder role: arn:aws:iam::334455667788:role/Oceancrest-LogPush. See /var/log/forwarder/2026-03-21.log
Riya (CS): They rotated Sumo credentials yesterday; likely mismatch in config. Also their forwarder role needs permissions: `sumologic:PutEvents` (or equivalent) scoped to the collector.
ops-oncall: Created ticket CS-7782: "OceanCrest privnet blockers: CIDR/KMS/logs" assigned to Ethan and Marta. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/CS-7782
Anya (CSM): Marking P0 due to renewal risk. I'll join triage and coordinate legal if needed. Can we do internal sync Friday 09:30 PT to align before I send the customer note?
Ethan (NetEng): Scheduling ok. Action items: I will upload network diagrams and a short-cost delta for NAT vs TransitGW to CS-7782 by EOD.
Marta (Security): I'll prepare exact IAM trust policy text, CMK key-policy snippet, and a short smoke-test checklist: assume-role validate, kms:Decrypt smoke, forwarder Sumo push check.
Riya (CS): Thanks. I'll draft the customer update template after our Friday sync and include owners + ETA. :thumbsup:
